title: knitCompanion Counter Session Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Ravelry projects (`ravelry:project`), knitCompanion row counters (`knitcompanion:counter`), Shelly smart-plug machine runtime (`shelly:status`), and Ravelry stash entries (`ravelry:stash`).
app: Ravelry project and stash exports, knitCompanion row-counter logs, and Shelly plug telemetry for sewing-machine hours sent to Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=knitcompanion:counter
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by pattern_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>24
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when knitCompanion counter session data has stopped arriving for a given pattern name.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per pattern name and alert when the feed is older than 24 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It measures when one part of your knitCompanion counter session feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
